name: 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilin and trioxilin synthesis
rationale: All members concern the 12-lipoxygenase branch producing 12-HETE derivatives (hepoxilins, trioxilins), unlike confusables built on 5-/15-lipoxygenase lipoxin synthesis, eicosanoid catabolism or epidermal barrier lipids.

name: Cranial nerve development and cranial neuron migration
rationale: Members cover trigeminal, facial, olfactory nerve and cranial ganglion development plus branchiomotor guidance, hindbrain tangential and GnRH neuron migration, distinguishing it from inner ear, peripheral ganglion and nasal/gland confusables.

name: Epidermal wound repair via keratinocyte proliferation and migration
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte and epithelial migration and proliferation, epidermal spreading, IL-20 signalling and wound inflammation, whereas confusables centre on keratinocyte differentiation, apoptosis and adhesion.

qualifier: assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol efflux
name: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol efflux
rationale: Members span chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL assembly, remodeling and clearance, ABC-transporter sterol efflux and intestinal lipid absorption, beyond confusables limited to SREBP/LDLR endocytosis, vitamin E or triglyceride catabolism.

name: Calcium-dependent and spontaneous neurotransmitter vesicle fusion
rationale: All members concern the vesicle fusion step of neurotransmitter release (calcium-triggered and spontaneous), unlike confusables on release cycles, docking/priming or presynaptic calcium and synaptic plasticity.

name: Transferrin-mediated cellular iron uptake and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover iron import, iron homeostasis and transferrin endocytosis/DMT1 transport, distinguishing it from heme scavenging and oxygen/redox confusables.

name: Protein nuclear import and export regulation targeted by SARS coronaviruses
rationale: Members regulate protein nuclear import and export with SARS-CoV-1/2 host-targeting pathways, distinguishing it from confusables on nuclear pore/RNA export, viral protein maturation or senescence.

name: Response to pesticides, dioxins and heavy metals
rationale: Members are responses to environmental toxicants (pesticides, dioxin/AhR ligands, bisphenol A, lead, mercury, cobalt), unlike confusables on ethanol/nicotine, antioxidant vitamins or iron/selenium.

core: Bone remodeling by osteoblasts and osteoclasts
name: Wnt-regulated bone remodeling by osteoblasts and osteoclasts
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and osteoclast differentiation, bone resorption and mineralization with Wnt signalling and its antagonists, unlike confusables driven by IGF, FGF23/phosphate or TGF-beta/BMP.

name: Beta-oxidation of medium, long and branched-chain fatty acids
rationale: Members are fatty acid beta-oxidation across medium, long, very long and branched (pristanoyl) chains, distinguishing it from confusables on ALD/VLCFA-CoA catabolism, alpha-oxidation and peroxisome maintenance.

name: Proteolytic activation of Notch and ERBB4 receptors
rationale: Members describe regulated intramembrane proteolysis releasing NOTCH1-4 and ERBB4 intracellular domains, whereas confusables cover NICD target transcription, Wnt or Hedgehog signalling.

name: Brainstem and pons development with neural respiratory control
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/brainstem/pons development and maturation plus neural regulation of breathing, unlike confusables on cerebellum, spinal cord patterning or cranial nerves.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis and recruitment
rationale: Members concern neutrophil/granulocyte chemotaxis and recruitment via formyl peptide GPCRs, distinguishing it from confusables on degranulation, extravasation or monocyte chemokines.

name: Drug ADME with glycine and glutamine conjugation
rationale: Members are drug ADME pathways and mitochondrial amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids, unlike confusables featuring sulfonation, SLCO transport, acetylation or methylation.

name: SLC transport of amino acids, oligopeptides and urate
rationale: Members are SLC carrier-mediated membrane transport of neutral amino acids, peptides, urate and related transporter disorders, unlike confusables on cationic amino acids, hexoses or organic cations.

name: Leukotriene biosynthesis, transport and catabolism
rationale: All members concern leukotriene synthesis, export and degradation, whereas confusables cover lipoxins, leukotriene receptor signalling or P450 HETE/EET synthesis.

name: Motile cilia and sperm flagella, including left-right patterning
rationale: Members cover motile axoneme and multiciliogenesis, sperm flagellum, mucociliary and CSF flow and nodal-cilia left-right asymmetry, unlike confusables centred on primary cilium intraflagellar transport.

name: Iron homeostasis with oxygen sensing and redox response
rationale: Members combine iron import and homeostasis with oxygen detection, superoxide removal and selenium response, distinguishing it from transferrin, heme and iron-disease confusables.

name: Erythrocyte gas, ammonium and monocarboxylate membrane transport
rationale: Members cover red cell O2/CO2/NO exchange, Rh-glycoprotein ammonium and MCT/basigin lactate transport, unlike confusables on heme, iron or surfactant.

name: Mitochondrial beta-oxidation spiral of saturated and unsaturated acyl-CoAs
rationale: All members are the acyl-CoA dehydrogenase-driven chain-shortening steps of mitochondrial beta-oxidation, unlike confusables on carnitine shuttle, ketone bodies or peroxisomal oxidation.

name: G2/M transition and cyclin B-CDK1 checkpoint control
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, cyclin A/B events and Chk1/2 inactivation of cyclin B:CDK1, unlike confusables on p53 DNA damage response, E2F/G1-S or T-cell division.

name: Mammary stem, luminal, myoepithelial and alveolar cell lineages
rationale: All members are developmental lineages of mammary epithelial cell types, distinguishing it from confusables on mammary morphogenesis/lactation or prostate and reproductive tract development.

name: Peroxisomal very-long-chain fatty acid shortening to medium-chain acyl-CoAs
rationale: Members concern peroxisomal acyl-CoA oxidase beta-oxidation of very-long-chain fatty acids (ABCD1/ALD) yielding medium-chain acyl-CoAs plus peroxisome maintenance, unlike confusables on pristanoyl/long-chain catabolism, peroxisome import or alpha-oxidation.

name: SLC4 and SLC26 bicarbonate and inorganic anion exchange
rationale: Members are SLC4/SLC26-mediated bicarbonate, sulfate, oxalate, iodide and chloride transport and their disorders, unlike confusables on phosphate, cation-chloride cotransport, CFTR or carbonic anhydrase.

name: Cardiac intercalated disc desmosome and intermediate filament assembly
rationale: Members cover desmosome and intermediate filament assembly, cardiomyocyte adhesion and ventricular action potential, distinguishing it from sarcomere, gap junction/T-tubule and epithelial hemidesmosome confusables.
